scripts.text:
[Necko]
I'm sorry. Necko's store is...
Oh? Who's this?
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Long time no see!
How are you?
Nice to see you again!!
Anything new?
Wow~ I'm so glad to see you!
You! Stop by once in a while!
I might forget what you look like!
Pukakakakakakakakaka!!!
Very very nice to see you!!
It's so nice to see you like this!
Come to Alberta often!
Killing two birds with one stone!!
I get to see you, and shout also!!
How much better can it get!!!
Keuhahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Ppyakikakikakakakakakakaka!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
抱歉。涅科的店里...
哦？这是谁？
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！
好久不见！
最近怎么样？
很高兴再次见到你！！
有什么新鲜事吗？
哇~见到你真是太开心了！
你！偶尔也来逛逛吧！
我可能会忘记你长什么样了！
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！
非常非常高兴见到你！！
像这样见到你真好！
常来艾尔贝塔吧！
一举两得！！
既能见到你，又能大喊大叫！！
还能比这更棒吗！！！
咳哈哈哈哈哈！！
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！
噗呀咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, did you come because
you are infatuated with my voice?
My voice is loud, isn't it!
considering you can hear it from a distance.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，你是因为迷恋我的声音才来的吗？
我的声音很响吧！
毕竟你能从那么远的地方听到。
而且。
（四处张望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't just loud!
!
Once you are about a level 15 merchant
I will tell you the secret!
Then, come again!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的声音不仅仅是响！
！
当你成为15级的商人时
我会告诉你秘密！
到时候，再来找我！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Uahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Kyukwakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
呜啊哈哈哈哈哈！
库哇咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh! You!
You are qualified to learn how to shout!
Learn how to shout with my help.
Would you like to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦！你！
你有资格学习如何大喊了！
在我的帮助下学习如何大喊。
你想学习大声呐喊吗？

scripts.text: Yes!!!!
No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Ahahahahaha!! Good!!!
That's the spirit!
Here we go!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
啊哈哈哈哈哈！！好！！
就是这个精神！
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You have learned Crazy Uproar!!
Shout as much as you wish!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
你学会了大声呐喊！！
想喊就喊吧！
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Eh... ok.
Pooooh...
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
呃...好吧。
噗...（失望地叹气）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 SP, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point on.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大声呐喊利用你响亮的声音
来提升战斗精神
消耗8点SP，可以在5分钟内
额外获得4点力量!!!!!
如果重复使用
持续时间从那时起重新计算为5分钟。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
and when you need to fight
it will gather your spirit.
Very useful, I must say!!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平时保持轻松自在，
需要战斗时
它会聚集你的精神。
非常有用，我必须说!!!!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, were you charmed 
by my voice?
Indeed, my voice is loud!
You can hear it from so far away.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，你是被我的声音迷住了吗？
确实，我的声音很响！
你能从那么远的地方听到。
而且。
（四处张望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't JUST loud!
I have learned the skill
that lets me shout..
The Crazy Uproar skill!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的声音不仅仅是响！
我学会了
让我能大喊的技能..
大声呐喊技能！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 sp, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大声呐喊利用你响亮的声音
来提升战斗精神
消耗8点SP，可以在5分钟内
额外获得4点力量!!!!!
如果重复使用
持续时间从那时起重新计算为5分钟。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
but shout to gather more
strength when you fight.
It is very useful!!!!
To learn this skill, you first need
to learn the essentials of sound!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平时保持轻松自在，
但在战斗时大喊以聚集更多
力量。
非常有用!!!!
要学习这个技能，你首先需要
学习声音的基础知识！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You can learn this in Payon
from a singer with just a loud voice
You can take lessons from him!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
你可以在斐扬
从一个声音很大的歌手那里学到
你可以向他请教！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
But that person died!
So you can't learn it anymore!
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
..............................
...Aww you look disappointed?
Do you want to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
但那个人死了！
所以你现在学不到了！
哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
..............................
...哎呀，你看起来很失望？
你想学大声呐喊吗？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Hmm... Shall I teach you?
If you really want it, that is.
First, I must scorch the vocal cords.
There are some things needed to do so.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
嗯...我要教你吗？
如果你真的想要的话。
首先，我必须灼烧声带。
为此需要一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
7 Pearls, 1 bottle of Banana Juice,
and 50 mushroom spores!
Then I'll scorch your vocal chord!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
7颗珍珠，1瓶香蕉汁，
和50个香菇芽孢！
然后我会灼烧你的声带！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
See you when you are ready!
I shall prepare my throat for then as well!!
Bboowuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh~~~!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
等你准备好了再来找我！
我也会为那时准备好我的喉咙！！
布呜呼~~~~~~！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Necko's store is closed right now.
come again later. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
涅科的店铺现在关门了。
请稍后再来。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[!?]
Muahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[！？]
穆阿哈哈哈哈哈哈！！
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm? I was wondering who was making all
the raucus carrying around a cart.
It was you.
Yes, I remember you.
what do you think? The new cart..good, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
嗯？我还在纳闷是谁在吵吵闹闹地推着车。
原来是你啊。
没错，我记得你。
你觉得怎么样？新车...不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Enjoy life.
Life isn't just simply moving
forward..Slowly, looking around,
dragging a heavy cart is
the way us merchants live.
Then see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
享受生活吧。
生活不仅仅是向前赶路...慢慢走，四处看看，
拖着沉重的车，
这就是我们商人的生活方式。
下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Be healthy~
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
保重身体~

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Nice to see you fellow merchant
If I remember correctly,
you're that famous merchant
these days.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
很高兴见到你，同行。
如果我没记错的话，
你最近可是个有名的商人呢。

scripts.text:
But your cart doesn't
seem to fit your fame.
How pitiful.
scripts.translation:
但你的手推车
似乎配不上你的名声。
真可怜。

scripts.text: That's why I came here.
scripts.translation: 所以我才来这里。

scripts.text: What about my cart?
scripts.translation: 我的车怎么了？

scripts.text: Two pairs is pitiful?
scripts.translation: 两对轮子很可怜吗？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Haha! Ok, ok!
With the things you brought
I will change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
哈哈！好吧，好吧！
用你带来的东西，
我会改装你的车。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Congratulations.
You can choose a cart
according to your taste.
And now you don't even need
me to help you. All you
need is some SP.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
恭喜。
现在你可以按照自己的喜好选择车了。
而且你甚至不需要
我再帮你了。你只需要
一些SP。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Convenient, don't you think?
Oh and one more thing!
Each time you level, you can
have a new different cart
So work hard.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
很方便，不是吗？
哦，还有一件事！
每次升级，你都可以
换一辆不同的车。
所以加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But anyways, it looks very nice on you!
Hahaha! Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
不过话说回来，你看起来很不错！
哈哈！祝你愉快！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm... It's true that I
change carts but...
In order to do so, I need
some materials to use.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
嗯...确实是我
在改装车，但是...
为了做到这一点，我需要
一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
50 Trunks.
10 Iron.
20 Animal Skins.
I need at least these things
to change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
50个树干。
10个铁。
20个动物外皮。
我至少需要这些东西
才能改装你的车。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
So come see me when you
have prepared everything.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
所以等你准备好一切
再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Oh no, you don't know at all?(changes tone)
A new way to show off a merchant's ego!
An expression of an excellent brain!
Change Cart is a skill that
makes a merchant stand out!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
哦不，你完全不知道吗？（语气变化）
一种展示商人自尊的新方式！
优秀头脑的体现！
改装手推车是一项
让商人脱颖而出的技能！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
A fun skill that allows you to
use a cart according to your
level with only 40 SP!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
一个有趣的技能，让你可以
根据等级使用手推车，
只需要40 SP！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
That is Change Cart!
A basic skill for any merchant.
I'll teach you how to make
one so watch carefully, and
do exactly what I do to make
your own in the future!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
这就是改装手推车！
任何商人的基本技能。
我会教你如何制作，
请仔细看，并完全照着我的做，
以便你以后能自己制作！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But, since it's the first time
you need to prepare some materials.
50 Trunks!
10 Iron!
20 Animal skins!
-bring these please!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
不过，既然是第一次，
你需要准备一些材料。
50个树干！
10个铁！
20个动物外皮！
-请把这些带过来！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
All we have to do is
make one using those materials,
so come back when you are ready.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
我们要做的只是
用这些材料改装一辆，
所以等你准备好了再来。
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
...it's not 'CARD'!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
...不是“卡片”！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Welcome young one.
Is selling fun? I am the
merchant Charlron. I have been
doing some research about.
carts recently.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
欢迎光临，年轻人。
做生意有趣吗？我是商人查尔隆。
最近我一直在研究手推车。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Aren't you tired of that cart?
Come to me if you want to
change your cart. I'll do a good job.
But, there are some conditions.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
你是不是厌倦了那辆手推车？
如果你想改装手推车，就来找我吧。
我会做得很好。
不过，有一些条件。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I'm a pretty famous merchant,
so I don't really deal with beginners.
Once you are level 30
I may consider establishing
a deal with you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
我是个相当有名的商人，
所以我不太接待新手。
一旦你达到30级，
我可能会考虑与你达成交易。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I am a merchant that
deals with many things, Charlron.
If you ever find anything interesting
come back and try to 
negotiate a deal with me.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
我是商人查尔隆，
经营着许多东西。
如果你发现任何有趣的东西，
回来找我，试着
与我达成交易。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, long time no see!
Ohh, the red marks on your cart.
They must be the marks of 'it'...
Seems like I have taught you the skill correctly!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
啊，好久不见！
哦，你手推车上的红色痕迹。
那一定是“它”的痕迹...
看来我教你技能教对了！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
You have blood like mine in you!
Mmm! After all!!
I'm happy! Scratch my back!
Here! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
你身上流着我的血！
嗯！毕竟！！
我很高兴！帮我挠挠背！
给！快点！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh. You have a firm body
for a merchant. You must be
very good a carrying things!?
Mmm you should be able to learn
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦。对于一个商人来说，
你的身体很结实。你一定
很擅长搬运东西！？
嗯，你应该能学会
手推车攻击！

scripts.text: Hey~ that's why I came.
scripts.translation: 嘿~ 这就是我来找你的原因。

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hoho!
Got it! I shall teach you
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
呵呵！
明白了！我会教你
手推车攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
啊，今天天气真好！
我会奖励那些
积极挥舞手推车的人！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using this amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
现在你可以使用手推车攻击了。
我期待你利用这种惊人的
破坏力让商人名扬四海。穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a great day!!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thank you very much!
...............Kaah!
Very refreshing! Thank you! Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦！
是香蕉汁！
非常感谢！
...............啊哈！
非常清爽！谢谢！再见！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You are still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the Banana Juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯？
你还没走？
啊！你还对
手推车攻击念念不忘！
好吧。考虑到你带了
香蕉汁，我就教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
教你手推车攻击并不难，
但我需要你准备
改装手推车的材料。
我需要的物品是..

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
首先我需要20个铁来让手推车
耐用。然后30个粘稠液体来吸收
冲击。
大约20个苍蝇翅膀和5个触手？
还有2瓶葡萄汁给我！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
只要带这些来就行。
我没说只要30个或20个。
这取决于我的状态！
哈哈哈！
我会等着的。那么再见~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯！
没有清爽的饮料可不行！
不如先带一瓶香蕉汁
来开启对话吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，味道不错！
很好！我就教你
...手推车攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
啊，今天天气真好！
我会奖励那些
积极挥舞手推车的人！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using its amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
现在你可以使用手推车攻击了。
我期待你利用它惊人的破坏力
让商人们声名远扬。穆哈哈哈哈哈！！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦！
是香蕉汁！
非常感谢！
...............啊哈！
非常清爽！谢谢！再见！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯？
你还没走？
啊！你还对
手推车攻击念念不忘！
好吧。考虑到你带了
香蕉汁，我就教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
教你手推车攻击并不难，
但我需要你准备
改装手推车的材料。
我需要的物品是..

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
首先我需要20个铁来让手推车
耐用。然后30个粘稠液体来吸收
冲击。
大约20个苍蝇翅膀和5个触手？
还有2瓶葡萄汁给我！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Bring these to me.
But that doesn't mean I want only 30 and 20.
It all depends on my condition!
Just bring me these for now.

scripts.text:

Mmm!
Nothing's free nowadays!
How about trying to start a conversation
by offering a bottle of Banana Juice or something?
scripts.translation:

嗯！
现在没有免费的东西了！
不如试着送一瓶香蕉汁
来开启对话？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

很好！我就教你
...手推车攻击！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

啊，今天天气真好！
我会奖励那些
积极挥舞手推车的人！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using its amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
现在你可以使用手推车攻击了。
我期待你利用它惊人的破坏力
让商人们声名远扬。穆哈哈哈哈哈！！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's Banana Juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦！
是香蕉汁！
非常感谢！
...............啊哈！
非常清爽！谢谢！再见！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:

嗯？
你还没走？
啊！你还对
手推车攻击念念不忘！
好吧。考虑到你带了
香蕉汁，我就教你吧。

scripts.text:

改装手推车的材料。

the shock.

And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:

首先我需要20个铁来让手推车

scripts.text:

Listen carefully.

手推车攻击。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
我研究过
使用手推车的不同方式。
我试过煮拉面，
甚至试过跳绳。
但没有任何一项
能让我满意。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
In despair, I wandered
through the fields with my cart.
After wandering dazed day after day..
I met a very strong monster.
Life was in danger!
Why me - a weaponless, armor-less merchant!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
在绝望中，我推着车
在田野里游荡。
日复一日地茫然游荡后...
我遇到了一只非常强大的魔物。
生命受到了威胁！
为什么是我——一个没有武器、没有盔甲的商人！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I was scared to death.. thinking
and hoping that this wasn't the
last of me. With little hope left
I tried the last thing possible.
I used my cart to hit the monster!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
我吓得要死...想着
希望这不是我的终点。在希望所剩无几时
我尝试了最后的可能。
我用我的车撞向了那只魔物！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The monster died in one hit.
It was then that I realized something.
Carts can become weapons, too!
I finally realized that we can
attack with carts!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
那只魔物一击就死了。
就在那时，我意识到了什么。
手推车也可以成为武器！
我终于意识到我们可以
用手推车攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Cart Revolution!
That's the new attack skill I developed.
Using 12 SP you lift your cart
to hit your opponent..
right in the head!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
手推车攻击！
那是我开发的新攻击技能。
消耗12点SP，你举起你的车
去撞击对手...
正中头部！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The heavier your cart is, the
stronger you can attack! With one hit,
your opponent will be hurt and
forced to back off!
This is Cart Revolution!

你的车越重，
攻击就越强！一击之下，
对手会受伤并
被迫后退！
这就是手推车攻击！
